meta.title: Jumper · Learn hardware on a 3D breadboard
meta.description: Connect real boards on a 3D breadboard. Jumper guides you like a game.

pitch.title: Wire real boards on a 3D breadboard.
pitch.body: Jumper is a web app where you learn hardware engineering. You connect real boards and parts on a 3D breadboard, and the app guides you like a game. You do not buy parts. You need only a laptop or a phone.

volt: Hi, I am Volt! I help you wire your first board.

cards.title: Put the LED in the breadboard.

cards.title: Connect the board pin to the LED.

cards.label: Level 2 · Code
cards.title: Complete the code to turn on the light.

cards.label: Level 2 · Check
cards.title: Press Check. Jumper tests your circuit.

cards.label: Level 5 · Face
cards.title: Perch wakes up and shows its face.

board.label: Perch, wired on the 3D breadboard. Select the board to make an account.

items.title: Pick a project
items.body: Each project is a real device. Start with Perch, a desk friend for an AI agent.

items.title: Wire it with guided pop-ups
items.body: A pop-up tells you what to connect, where, and why. The correct holes glow.

items.title: See it come alive
items.body: Pass each level. The light blinks, the device talks, and the screen shows a face.

end.title: Your first board is ready.
end.body: Make an account. Your builds stay yours.
